desc:
Welcome to World War II Zombie Survival! Fight against countless oncoming waves of zombies in various WW2 environments! Earn points from killing zombies to purchase new weapons and vehicle from different wwii factions/nations and unleash them in battle! 

Step into the boots of an elite commando, led by a cast of characters, that take you on missions around the world to combat the relentless zombie threat.

👍 Leave a like if you enjoyed! 

💻📱 The game may not perform as well on lower-end or older devices. Keep in mind that this game is still unfinished!

❗ Shutdowns for updates or maintenances! 

🎖️ Join our WW2ZS fan group to receive access to future group-exclusive features! You can find the link in the game page! https://www.roblox.com/groups/11804655

⚠️Since this game is a work in progress, please be patient and report any issues you find. The stability of your in-game statistics cannot be guaranteed.
